entries.title: Crewmates can read whatever your GitHub or GitLab sign-in can see
entries.body: Crewmates are no longer limited to repositories and search: they can read anything your sign-in can see, such as your notifications or your organizations' members. A task in a project kept on this computer reads GitHub through your GitHub sign-in. Your sign-in's own permissions still decide what they see.
entries.noPicture: This changes which reads a crewmate's calls reach, without changing any visible view.
